task.title: Apply Narrative Craft from the first roleplay reply
task.source: User report that Narrative Craft did not affect the opening reply
task.classification: engine generation, prompt assembly, detached agent cadence, and direct-message parity

coreClaim: An active Narrative Craft agent supplies one zero-extra-call craft instruction to every supported roleplay writer path from the first reply, then analyzes that completed reply in detached background work and returns to its normal four-assistant-message cadence.
rootCause: Automatic Narrative Craft guidance existed only after a validated prior intervention, recurrence filtering skipped the first critic run, and the supported direct-message writer path bypassed the agent runtime entirely.

inScope: One baseline Narrative Craft instruction on normal and direct-message roleplay generation
First completed-response analysis when no saved craft state exists
Persisted state anchoring for later recurrence and cadence gates
Final high-priority prompt placement without a second writer call
outOfScope: Synchronous rewriting of a completed response
A guarantee that every model response beats StoryScope
Changing the configured writer or Agent model
New storage schemas, APIs, settings, or UI

claimBoundary.coreClaim: The writer receives one advisory craft block before its existing model call; explicit style and established voice remain authoritative, and the first critic runs only after the visible reply completes.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt, model-call count, background ordering, persistence, and cross-entrypoint compatibility
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing Narrative Craft state counts as established state
Explicit replay injection overrides remain authoritative
Chats without active Narrative Craft remain unchanged
outOfScopeClaims: No claim that StoryScope is a production quality score.
No claim that a prompt can force every provider sample to avoid every flagged device.
No claim that detached analysis has zero quota or token cost.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Narrative Craft promised later-reply learning but did not protect or analyze the first generated reply on every supported writer path.
contractLaneGate.producer: src/engine/generation creates the writer request and saves the completed assistant response.
contractLaneGate.consumer: The roleplay writer prompt and the next Narrative Craft cadence decision.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Active Narrative Craft should influence the first reply without adding foreground calls, then establish readable state for later sparse analysis.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: agent-runner owns baseline composition and first-state detection; generation-guide owns final system placement; start-generation supplies normal/direct parity and detached scheduling.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The TypeScript generation engine owns prompt assembly, model-call count, saved output, agent state, and background scheduling.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not rewrite prose in React, add a second foreground model call, or encode the behavior only in bundled preset JSON.
regressionProof: Focused runtime tests prove baseline composition, consume-once guidance, state round-trip, cadence, and replay behavior.
Request-level integration tests prove one final Narrative Craft block and detached first analysis on normal and direct-message paths.

positiveRows.claim: The first writer request gets one craft instruction without a pre-generation provider request.
positiveRows.evidence: agent-runner and start-generation focused tests count one narrative_craft block while the writer remains the first provider request.

positiveRows.claim: A first quiet response still establishes persistent craft state.
positiveRows.evidence: The state round-trip test runs a no-candidate first analysis, reloads its persisted state, and proves the next no-candidate response creates no critic request.

positiveRows.claim: Visible completion remains ahead of the critic.
positiveRows.evidence: Normal and direct-message integration tests reach the done event before the critic starts, then observe detached persistence.

contradictionRows.claim: The baseline must not become a universal house style.
contradictionRows.evidence: The final wording makes explicit user style authoritative, exempts established voice and intentional devices, leaves clean prose alone, and corrects only accidental or repeated clustering.

contradictionRows.claim: A single Harlequin sample must not be reported as a detector win when it is not one.
contradictionRows.evidence: Pinned StoryScope full-arc scoring was effectively tied but slightly favored baseline; the result is recorded as a non-blocking limitation rather than a pass.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Saved Narrative Craft state does not trigger another forced first analysis.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The saved-state no-candidate regression remains recurrence-gated.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Inactive chats and explicit replay overrides preserve their existing selection boundary.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Focused runtime tests keep inactive behavior empty and preserve explicit overrides without synthesizing a baseline.

untestedRows: The exact Harlequin full-arc treatment did not beat StoryScope: full delta -0.0044 and narrative-without-style delta -0.0636 in the final scored iteration.
StoryScope feature extraction is model-assisted and repeated baseline extraction showed variance; it is diagnostic rather than a deterministic release oracle.

ownedFacts.description: The baseline adds no extra foreground model call.
ownedFacts.evidence: Focused tests assert zero provider requests during runtime construction and one writer request before detached analysis.

ownedFacts.description: The exact Harlequin treatment retained reader quality despite its detector result.
ownedFacts.evidence: Three blind judges preferred treatment two to one.

manualBlockers.reason: The deterministic release claim is first-turn coverage and call ordering, not guaranteed detector classification; the broader prior 52-pair Narrative Craft evaluation remains favorable.

reviewThreadLedger.fix: Direct roleplay generation now uses an automatic Narrative-Craft-only runtime, one final guide, cadence-aware detached analysis, and saved context-injection metadata.

reviewThreadLedger.finding: The strict baseline could override intentional literary devices.
reviewThreadLedger.fix: The baseline now makes explicit style authoritative and limits correction to accidental or repeated clusters while preserving established voice and intentional devices.

verification.baselineEvidence: Focused Vitest, TypeScript, architecture, deterministic repository checks, Rust workspace compilation, and git diff whitespace checks pass on the implementation branch.
edgeRowsTested: No saved state and saved state
No recurrence candidate and recurrence candidate
negativeRowsTested: No second no-candidate critic after state persistence
